content:
This is my first boat ride, Patricia.
It's mine too, Sandra.
Is it safe?
I thinks so. Daddy goes all the time.
He told me we can row the boat.
Row the boat?
Yes. Take this oar and row.
Wow. This is fun. We are moving.
